Frequently Asked Questions
Common questions about Vim's valuation, stock price, and market status.
Is Vim a public or private company?
Vim is a private company.What is the current stock price of Vim?
Vim is a private company, so its shares have no public market price. Caplight tracks Vim's secondary market activity and provides MarketPrice™ estimates of its share price to Caplight users.How much is Vim worth (valuation)?
Valuation information for Vim is not publicly available.Can I buy Vim stock?
Vim shares may be available on secondary markets subject to transfer restrictions. Caplight facilitates secondary market transactions for accredited investors.When was Vim's last funding round?
Vim's most recent funding round was Series C on May 5, 2021.Who are the main investors in Vim?
Key investors in Vim include GreatPoint Ventures, Frist Cressey Ventures, GreatPoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Optum Ventures.Will Vim IPO soon?
No public IPO plans have been announced for Vim.How can I track Vim secondary market activity?
Caplight tracks bids, offers, and trades in Vim's shares on secondary markets.
